title: Correct QCLI-210's stale reviewer-gate note and document permanent post-recreation gitHead 404s
description: Discovered as a side effect of QCLI-271 (0.6.2 release) while answering an opum-agent/lore-cli cross-session question about reconfiguring npm OIDC trusted publishing after the 2026-09-10 repository recreation (OPAG-70). Two facts surfaced that needed correcting/documenting on their own, outside QCLI-271's acceptance criteria: QCLI-210's Done-state note claiming the release environment's required-reviewers gate 'remains open' had gone stale (the gate is now live), and QCLI-267's dangling-gitHead fix, measured only against 0.6.0, actually applies to all 8 versions published before v0.6.1. Split into its own task/PR per opum-agent's orchestrator direction: the runbook paragraph exists to pre-empt a false tampering alarm and should not wait on 0.6.2's release, which is separately blocked on human npm credential work with no ETA.

acceptanceCriteria.text: QCLI-210 carries a comment (not a rewrite of its Done notes/final summary) correcting that the release environments required-reviewers gate is live, not an open decision
QCLI-267 carries a comment noting the dangling-gitHead defect it fixed forward for 0.6.0 spans all 8 versions published before v0.6.1
docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md documents that a 404 on an old published versions gitHead is expected and permanent, not tampering
The change is merged into dev via its own pull request, landed ahead of and independently from the QCLI-271 0.6.2 release PR
